operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: How the app works and the email block format: block types and fields, design keys, placeholders, campaign statuses, and what sending does.

operations.name: dashboard.get
operations.description: The Dashboard: audience counts, 30-day subscriber growth, scheduled and draft campaigns, recent sends and quick-start templates.

operations.name: subscribers.list
operations.description: Subscribers, newest first, with the Subscribers screen's filters, the tag counts and the total number matching.

tag.description: Only subscribers with exactly this tag.

search.description: Text contained in the email or the name (case-insensitive).

operations.name: subscribers.add
operations.description: Add a subscriber as the Add form does; an email already on the list is updated instead (name set if given, tags merged).

operations.name: subscribers.import
operations.description: Import pasted CSV as Import CSV does: one 'email, first name, last name' per line; existing emails are updated, new ones subscribed.

csv.description: CSV text, one subscriber per line; names optional; lines starting with # are skipped.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags added to every imported subscriber.

operations.name: subscribers.export
operations.description: Export the subscribed audience as CSV text (email, name, tags).

operations.name: templates.list
operations.description: Templates as the Templates screen shows them (most used first), without their blocks, with the total.

operations.name: templates.get
operations.description: One template with its subject, preheader, blocks and design.

include_data_urls.description: Show uploaded images in full instead of shortened.

operations.name: templates.create
operations.description: Create a template as New blank template does (a 'Hello!' heading and one paragraph unless blocks are given).

preheader.description: Preview text shown after the subject.

operations.name: templates.update
operations.description: Change a template's name, subject, preheader, blocks (whole array) or design (merged), as the template editor saves it.

blocks.description: Replacement array of blocks; to change one block use blocks.edit.

design.description: Design keys to change, merged into the current design.

operations.name: templates.duplicate
operations.description: Copy a template as '{name} (copy)' with the same subject, preheader, blocks and design.

operations.name: templates.delete
operations.description: Delete a template; campaigns started from it keep their content.

operations.name: campaigns.list
operations.description: Campaigns as the Campaigns screen shows them (last edited first; scheduled ones by send time), with the total.

status.description: Only this status (the screen's filter chips).

operations.name: campaigns.get
operations.description: One campaign: content, design, audience (who a send records) and whether it is editable.

include_data_urls.description: Show uploaded images in full instead of shortened.

operations.name: campaigns.preview
operations.description: The email as the Review tab renders it, personalised for the first subscribed contact.

operations.name: campaigns.create
operations.description: Create a draft campaign, blank or from a template (copies its content and counts one use).

name.description: Campaign name (default 'New campaign', or '{template name} — campaign').

operations.name: campaigns.update
operations.description: Edit a campaign that is not sent, as the editor saves it: any of its fields, its blocks or its design.

preheader.description: Preview text shown after the subject.

from_name.description: From name for this campaign (empty uses Settings).

from_email.description: From email for this campaign (empty uses Settings).

target_all.description: true = everyone subscribed; false = by tag.

target_tags.description: Comma-separated tags used when target_all is false.

blocks.description: Replacement array of blocks; to change one block use blocks.edit.

design.description: Design keys to change, merged into the current design.

operations.name: campaigns.duplicate
operations.description: Copy a campaign (any status) as a new draft '{name} (copy)'.

operations.name: campaigns.delete
operations.description: Delete a campaign of any status, with its recorded recipients.

operations.name: campaigns.schedule
operations.description: Schedule a campaign for a future time; the app then records the send exactly as Send now does.

scheduled_at.description: Future date and time, ISO 8601 ending in Z or an offset, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z.

operations.name: campaigns.cancel
operations.description: Cancel a scheduled send; the campaign stays as a cancelled draft and can be scheduled again.

operations.name: campaigns.send-now
operations.description: Send now as the app's Send does: records the campaign's audience (everyone subscribed, or by its tags) and marks it sent; no email is delivered.

operations.name: campaigns.ai-write
operations.description: AI-write a campaign as the editor's AI writer does, replacing its subject, preheader and blocks.

audience.description: Who it is for, e.g. 'early customers'.

operations.name: blocks.edit
operations.description: Add (append), change, move or remove one block in a campaign or template, as the editor canvas does.

block.description: add: a block with a type (missing fields get the editor's defaults); update: the fields to change.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: Sender name and email, reply-to, the footer organization and address, and the integration state the Settings screen shows.

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change the sender name and email, reply-to, or footer organization and address, as Save on the Settings screen does.

organization_name.description: Organization name shown in the email footer.

organization_address.description: Mailing address shown in the email footer.

operations.name: ai.draft
operations.description: Draft a newsletter (subject + body) from a topic via the host's language model (503 when none is connected).

topic.description: What the newsletter should be about.

operations.name: integrations.status
operations.description: Whether the CraftBot LLM bridge is configured (used to show an honest AI-writer connected/disconnected state).
